title: build-app.sh --release: embed and sign Sparkle, set the feed address and the public update key
done_when: build/Tether.app has Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework, SUFeedURL and SUPublicEDKey only in --release builds, and passes a deep signature check
command: scripts/build-app.sh --release && codesign --verify --deep --strict build/Tether.app && plutil -extract SUPublicEDKey raw build/Tether.app/Contents/Info.plist
body: Signs nested code inside out (Sparkle's helpers first) with the same identity. The feed is a permanent release named appcast: .../releases/download/appcast/appcast.xml; --feed test points at appcast-test.xml for trial releases.
